description: Adversarial verification of the harness's fail-closed guarantees: a threat model, an adversarial fixture corpus, and a security test suite proving unauthorized, malformed, stale, and credential-bearing inputs can never advance a workflow.

sprint.goal: Prove mechanically that the harness fails closed on every defined abuse case, and that receipts and telemetry can never leak credentials.

stories.title: Threat model and adversarial fixture corpus
